title: Studio - Ryan Senatore Architecture
text: Studio - Ryan Senatore Architecture Skip to primary navigation Skip to main content Ryan Senatore Architecture Show/Hide Menu Work Studio Contact Studio We are a full-service architecture firm located in Portland, Maine, serving clients throughout the Eastern United States. With a commitment to innovation, client-centric design and creative solutions, RSA has built a well-earned reputation for excellence. Whether you’re embarking on a new residential development, commercial venture, or renovation project, RSA is dedicated to ensuring a collaborative experience with exceptional results. Philosophy We believe that transformative design must be rooted in innovation and collaboration to shape not only the spaces we design, but experiences visitors have in them. That’s why we approach our work with a keen understanding of how the natural world informs the built environment, allowing our firm to create vibrant, healthy spaces that respect the surrounding landscape. We tailor our design solutions to meet the unique needs of each client and project, delivering results that are not only aesthetically pleasing, but also sustainable and cost-effective. We’re committed to delivering projects that inspire clients, enrich communities, and stand the test of time. Experience RSA brings extensive experience to each project thanks to a diverse portfolio that includes multifamily residential, commercial interiors, high-tech laboratories, and manufacturing facilities. As you can see, we blend innovation with practical design to create memorable spaces regardless of the scale or setting. Sustainability and energy efficiency are core principles guiding our designs, reflecting our dedication to excellence and positive environmental impact. Our Team Our team is united by a shared passion for creative design solutions and a commitment to excellence. From residential developments to commercial ventures, RSA’s team of architects has the experience to tackle any challenge with ingenuity and precision. Ryan Senatore Principal AIA LEED-AP BD+C Growing up in central Vermont, Ryan spent much of his time exploring it’s rich and varied landscape. This exploration helped develop an understanding of how the natural world informs the built environment by creating a sense of place, organization, structure, material and form. Upon graduating from Roger Williams University, Ryan moved to Portland, Maine in 2002. Since then Ryan has built many professional relationships in the design and construction world and beyond. In 2012 he formed Ryan Senatore Architecture (RSA) and has since been designing some of Southern Maine’s most exciting projects. He looks to continue to grow RSA and provide exceptional service to clients. Reid Tozier Architectural Designer Reid Tozier grew up in Falmouth, Maine, spending summers working for his father’s construction company, the Tozier Group. Throughout the years, Reid was exposed to many trades and techniques that furthered his love of building and made him interested in expanding his knowledge to design. After high school, Reid enrolled in the Architectural program at Wentworth Institute of Technology in Boston where he graduated with his masters of Architecture in 2010. After college, Reid took over the Tozier Group where he designed and built various residential projects over the next few years. In 2013, Reid joined with Ryan Senatore Architecture to pursue his dream of becoming an Architect and be part of an exciting high energy firm in Maine’s largest city. Currently, Reid lives in Falmouth with his wife Hannah, has been coaching the Falmouth high school hockey team for the last 6 season, and is an avid musician. Ethan Smythe Architectural Designer Growing up in a wide variety of urban and rural communities across Upstate New York, Ethan was exposed to a wide architectural vocabulary. Ethan also fostered a love for the arts throughout his youth. These qualities led Ethan to pursue a career in architecture, beginning his studies as part of the Architectural Technology program at Hudson Valley Community College and later transferring to the practice-oriented BArch program at Alfred State College. Ethan graduated summa cum laude with his Bachelor of Architecture degree in 2020. He began his term at RSA shortly thereafter, where he is now hard at work on some of Maine’s most exciting new projects. Ethan lives in Saco with his wife Allison, where they enjoy a quiet life. Caleb Stover Designer With a diverse background in Industrial and Interior design, Caleb brings a unique and complementary perspective to the team at RSA. After spending summers working for his father in the construction industry and pursuing the arts during his academic tenure, Caleb has been developing a promising career path in Architecture and design. With a keen eye for form and aesthetics, Caleb brings a practical approach to design, ensuring that every detail serves a purpose. While not designing, Caleb finds inspiration from the world during his time biking, motorcycling, taking photos, and playing music. He lives in Portland with his wife Elise. Jack Hanson Architectural Intern Growing up in southern Maine Jack now attends Keene State College in New Hampshire pursuing a major in Architecture with a minor in Safety. Jack joined RSA in 2023 for the summer as an intern while out of school, and has returned for 2024. While not in working Jack enjoys being outdoors during all seasons, mountain biking and downhill skiing. Let’s Work Together We’re passionate about turning ideas into reality.
